attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: incoming_email_classification
steps:
  - id: poll_gmail_inbox
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/gmail/inbox/unread"
      polling_interval_minutes: 5
    output: raw_email_payload

  - id: validate_email_payload
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_email_payload
      schema: gmail_unread_email_schema
    output: validated_email_payload

  - id: extract_email_body
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email_payload
      field: "body"
    output: email_body

  - id: extract_thread_id
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email_payload
      field: "thread_id"
    output: thread_id

  - id: extract_sender_address
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_email_payload
      field: "sender_address"
    output: sender_address

  - id: check_club_domain_sender
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "sender_address ends_with '@club.example.com'"
      input_variable: sender_address
    output: is_club_sender

  - id: route_if_club_sender
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "is_club_sender == true"
      true_step: skip_classification_club_sender
      false_step: fetch_full_thread

  - id: skip_classification_club_sender
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_email_payload
      template:
        customer_support_required: false
        reason: "sender_is_club_domain"
        thread_id: "{{thread_id}}"
        sender: "{{sender_address}}"
    output: classification_result

  - id: route_to_audit_from_club
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "classification_result != null"
      true_step: log_classification_result

  - id: fetch_full_thread
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/gmail/threads/{{thread_id}}"
    output: raw_thread_data

  - id: validate_thread_data
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_thread_data
      schema: gmail_thread_schema
    output: validated_thread_data

  - id: build_thread_history
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_thread_data
      iterator_step: label_message_sender

  - id: label_message_sender
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_thread_data
      mapping:
        messages: "messages[*].{message_id: message_id, body: body, sender: sender, label: if(sender ends_with '@club.example.com', 'Club', 'Customer'), timestamp: timestamp}"
    output: labeled_thread_history

  - id: check_tax_receipt_request
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "email_body matches_any ['Releve 24', 'RL-24', 'releve 24', 'rl-24', 'relevé 24']"
      input_variable: email_body
    output: is_tax_receipt_request

  - id: route_tax_receipt
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "is_tax_receipt_request == true"
      true_step: force_classification_true
      false_step: prepare_classification_payload

  - id: force_classification_true
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: labeled_thread_history
      template:
        customer_support_required: true
        reason: "tax_receipt_request_detected"
        thread_id: "{{thread_id}}"
        sender: "{{sender_address}}"
    output: classification_result

  - id: route_to_audit_from_tax
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "classification_result != null"
      true_step: log_classification_result

  - id: prepare_classification_payload
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: labeled_thread_history
      mapping:
        thread_id: "{{thread_id}}"
        sender: "{{sender_address}}"
        current_email_body: "{{email_body}}"
        thread_history: "{{labeled_thread_history}}"
        supported_languages:
          - "EN"
          - "FR"
          - "ES"
    output: classification_request_payload

  - id: authenticate_for_ai_api
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "email_classification_agent"
    output: ai_auth_result

  - id: call_ai_classification
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      input: classification_request_payload
      url: "https://ai.club.example.com/api/classify-email"
      method: "POST"
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{ai_auth_result.token}}"
    output: raw_ai_response

  - id: validate_ai_response
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_ai_response
      schema: ai_classification_response_schema
    output: validated_ai_response

  - id: extract_classification
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_ai_response
      field: "customer_support_required"
    output: ai_classification_flag

  - id: build_final_classification
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: validated_ai_response
      template:
        customer_support_required: "{{ai_classification_flag}}"
        reason: "ai_classification"
        thread_id: "{{thread_id}}"
        sender: "{{sender_address}}"
        confidence: "{{validated_ai_response.confidence}}"
    output: classification_result

  - id: log_classification_result
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: classification_result
      event: "email_classification_completed"
      metadata:
        thread_id: "{{thread_id}}"
        sender: "{{sender_address}}"

  - id: handle_classification_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      on_error_in:
        - call_ai_classification
        - validate_ai_response
      route_to: retry_ai_classification

  - id: retry_ai_classification
    op: retry_step
    params:
      step: call_ai_classification
      max_retries: 3
      backoff_seconds: 30

  - id: terminate
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
